declaration.preface:
CTX Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. is committed to minimizing its environmental impact and supporting sustainable development through responsible environmental management and continuous improvement. As a vertically integrated manufacturer of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and intermediates, the Company recognises that its operations interact with the environment and seeks to prevent pollution, conserve natural resources, and comply with all applicable environmental laws, regulations, and certifications. CTX operates with a robust environmental infrastructure, including effluent treatment and waste management facilities, and maintains ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 standards to promote environmental stewardship.

This Environmental Policy establishes the framework for CTX Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd.’s environmental objectives and targets, defines governance and accountability mechanisms, and outlines key initiatives to enhance environmental performance across all business operations. It guides employees, contractors, and stakeholders in integrating sustainability principles into daily activities, with the aim of advancing energy efficiency, resource conservation, waste reduction, and overall ecological responsibility.
declaration.declaration: CTX Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. affirms its commitment to safeguarding the environment by preventing pollution, complying with all applicable environmental laws and regulations, and continually enhancing its environmental performance. The Company is dedicated to responsible management of natural resources, controlling emissions and effluents, minimizing waste, and integrating environmental considerations into all operational and business decisions. CTX Lifesciences fosters environmental awareness, accountability, and active engagement among employees, contractors, and stakeholders to promote sustainable practices across its operations.
declaration.scope: This Environmental Policy applies to all operations of CTX Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd., including chemical manufacturing, storage, laboratory, and supporting functions conducted at its facility. It covers environmental aspects related to resource consumption, energy use, emissions, effluents, waste management, and chemical handling. The Policy applies to all employees, contractors, and service providers working on behalf of CTX Lifesciences, ensuring that sustainability and environmental responsibility are embedded throughout the organization’s operations.

Energy Consumption & GHG Emissions: Improve energy efficiency by installing energy-efficient motors, pumps, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and LED lighting across operations.
Optimize boilers, chillers, utilities, and HVAC systems through preventive maintenance and operational controls.
Explore cleaner fuel alternatives to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
Air Emissions Control: Maintain and operate scrubbers, filters, and local exhaust ventilation systems to control process emissions.
Conduct regular stack and ambient air monitoring to ensure compliance with applicable air quality norms.
Reduce fugitive emissions through proper chemical storage, closed handling systems, and routine equipment maintenance.
Raw Materials Management: Optimize raw material consumption through batch optimization, yield improvement, and process standardization.
Minimize material losses by strengthening inventory management, storage conditions, and handling procedures.
Encourage efficient chemical dosing and substitution of high-loss materials where feasible.
Waste Management: Maintain implementation of waste segregation at source for hazardous, non-hazardous, recyclable, and recyclable packaging waste.
Recycle solvents, residues, and packaging materials through in-house recovery systems and authorized recyclers.
Ensure safe storage, documentation, and disposal of hazardous waste through approved waste management vendors.
Water Stewardship: Reduce freshwater usage through process optimization, leak prevention, and water-efficient practices.
Operate and optimize existing effluent treatment and water recycling systems to maximize reuse.
Monitor effluent quality regularly to ensure compliance with discharge standards.
Biodiversity Protection: Develop green belts around manufacturing sites with native tree plantations.
Collaborate with local environmental organizations to support habitat conservation.
Responsible Product Use: Provide customers with clear guidance on safe handling, storage, and efficient product usage.
Support customers with technical advice to minimize waste, emissions, and resource use during application.
Review customer feedback to improve product performance and environmental compatibility.
Product End-of-Life Management: Enable safe disposal and recovery of expired or off-spec products through authorized facilities.
Promote reuse or recycling of drums, containers, and packaging materials where feasible.
Maintain records of product disposal and recovery to support circular economy practices.
Customer Health & Safety: Ensure all products comply with chemical safety regulations before market release.
Maintain and update labeling, hazard communication, and SDS for regulatory compliance.
Monitor and review product safety performance to identify improvements in handling and usage.
Conduct targeted training for customers on safe handling practices and emergency response.
Employee Awareness & Engagement: Conduct role-based environmental training for employees covering waste management, emissions control, and spill prevention.
Integrate environmental responsibilities into SOPs and daily work practices to reinforce sustainable behavior.
Encourage employee participation in environmental improvement and compliance initiatives.
Environmental Services, Partnerships & A: Conduct employee training on environmental responsibility and sustainable practices.
Engage suppliers and contractors on environmental compliance and responsible material sourcing.
Support local environmental programs such as plantation drives and awareness initiatives.
Track environmental performance and promote continual improvement through internal reviews and reporting.

responsibilities.duty: Oversees implementation and monitoring of the Environmental Policy, ensures regulatory compliance, leads training, and coordinates environmental reporting.
Integrate environmental goals into departmental functions, collaborate with the EHS Manager, and implement initiatives such as waste reduction, water conservation, and energy efficiency.

policy.monitoring: CTX Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. continuously tracks its environmental performance across key areas, including energy consumption, greenhouse gas emissions, water management, waste reduction, and product safety. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are established for each area and monitored through internal systems to assess progress against defined sustainability targets. Performance results are reviewed quarterly and consolidated for senior management to support informed decision-making. Annual evaluations assess achievements, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions, with relevant outcomes communicated to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting adhere to applicable regulations and industry best practices to ensure reliability and accuracy.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Environmental Policy will be reviewed annually by the EHS Manager and updated as required to reflect changes in regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal environmental objectives. Updates will be communicated to all employees, contractors, and relevant stakeholders to ensure consistent application. Revisions aim to strengthen environmental commitments, enhance operational sustainability, and drive continuous improvement across all CTX operations.
